name: Ľudovít Ódor - Projet du Conseil
title: REPORT on the draft Council directive amending Directive 2006/112/EC as regards VAT rules for the digital age
part_text:
The European Parliament approves the Council's draft rules on value added tax (VAT) for the digital age. The rules introduce a new real-time digital reporting system based on electronic invoicing, update VAT rules for the platform economy, and create a single VAT registration for businesses selling to consumers across the EU. The Parliament is only consulted here, and it accepts the Council's text without changes. It asks to be told if the Council departs from this text, and to be consulted again if the draft changes substantially.

- **What changes:** New digital VAT reporting, platform economy rules, and one-stop VAT registration for online sellers.
- **Who it affects:** Businesses selling online, platforms, and tax authorities in EU member states.
- **What happens next:** The Council can adopt the directive; Parliament must be told of any major changes.
